summary: Independent deterministic checks pass. No substantive GT, leakage, scoring or result-existence defect was found. Qualification is required for training sufficiency, calibration-width inference, deployment availability and retrospective single-seed scope. The cached-calendar wording discrepancy has been accurately disclosed without altering the frozen protocol.

A_gt_provenance.details: Raw dataset labels are retained without imputation. Input eligibility is independent of future target validity. All 344664 target cells and 344664 history cells independently match raw CSVs.

B_score_normalization.details: Standard observed-label interval scores, pinball, WIS and MAE; no prediction-statistic denominator. Physical support clipping is disclosed. Nonnested separately calibrated intervals cannot be represented as a calibrated full CDF.

C_result_existence.details: All 148 input hashes and 10 code hashes match; complete artifacts and refit witnesses exist. Reported numerical values match primary arrays/tables. Earlier two token-precheck failures were resolved by exact primary-CSV parsing and independent numerical recomputation.

D_dead_code.details: Reported metric functions are invoked and their outputs independently match result files. Historical imported routines do not imply additional P0 experiments. The initial issued-date bootstrap is explicitly superseded by the executed calendar bootstrap.

E_scope.details: 17 frozen-model replays and two fixed seed-0 refits on previously inspected dates. All saved calibration states are temporally legal under zero latency, but deployment availability and causal attribution are not established. Width ratios do not establish a lower bound on other calibrators' achievable width. Full calendar-bootstrap results reproduce exactly; their intervals remain descriptive and model-conditional.

F_evaluation_type.details: Performance metrics use actual observed labels. Legacy model outputs are comparison targets solely for explicitly labeled reproduction. Synthetic fixtures are excluded from empirical results; target-defined subgroups are retrospective diagnostics.

claims.what_results_support: Local 17-forest q05/q95 replay and 90% rolling84 CQR endpoint reproduction, two fixed farm-1 seven-quantile seed-0 training witnesses, real-label scoring, and successful documented environment witnesses.
claims.what_results_dont_support: 17 from-scratch refits, multiple seeds, official competition equivalence, new-method effectiveness, fresh-holdout or deployed performance, or full-distribution calibration.
claims.missing_evidence: None required for the narrow local replay/two-witness claim. Broader training/environment/generalization assertions would require additional refits, clean environments, seeds and uninspected dates/sites.
claims.suggested_claim_revision: 在指定本地环境及既有历史划分上，17 个冻结 QRF 的 q05/q95 与 90% rolling84 CQR 完全复现；两套数据各 1 个预先指定风场的 seed=0 从头重训也完全复现。真实标签评分与独立复算一致。
next_experiments_needed: No further full training is necessary merely to establish the narrow P0 reproduction claim; retain the frozen baseline as a versioned control.

claims.what_results_support: Structured service gaps, conditional tail failures despite adequate macro coverage, near-zero losses associated with negative signed corrections, nonnesting, descriptive 2012 IS improvement with wider intervals, and no demonstrated 2014 IS improvement.
claims.what_results_dont_support: Causal decomposition among training data, optimization, model capacity and NWP information; sufficient training; a calibration-independent width floor; fault labels inferred from near-zero power; deployable subgroup selection using future labels; novel method effectiveness.
claims.missing_evidence: Controlled same-date/input interventions, validation-only optimization or learning-curve controls, same-information model comparisons, latency sensitivity, service-expanded assessment, and an uninspected confirmation split.
claims.suggested_claim_revision: P0 定位了可用性、条件覆盖、尾部误差及区间一致性的具体问题，但尚未识别这些误差由训练、表示或 NWP 信息分别造成的比例；后续方法仅作为待检验假设。
next_experiments_needed: Compare coherent full-distribution calibration with frozen static/rolling controls under identical label-arrival rules; evaluate CDF/nesting validity, boundary semantics, coverage, width and proper scores jointly.
Include a fixed-budget asymmetric-tail control using only issue-time conditioning information.
Evaluate a historical-power or strictly causal NWP fallback over the complete calendar, reporting service rate and both matched-subset and expanded-service performance.
For causal attribution, conduct validation-only learning-curve/model/input interventions and preserve an uninspected date/site split.

action_items.action: Align the opening training interpretation with REPORT.md:125: deterministic reproduction and persistence superiority do not test adequate optimization.
Narrow the width inference to the tested static/rolling CQR arms; raw/rolling width ratio alone does not establish the attainable width of other calibrators.
No rerun required. Preserve original protocol and the accurate appended explanation of full-calendar reconstruction versus cache-calendar equality.
Retain retrospective/single-seed, zero-latency, inferred-2014-NWP-clock and model-conditional bootstrap limitations. Do not promote this review to new-method or submission acceptance.
